messages.subject: R editor for Mac
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

I'm looking for a good R editor for Mac. On the PC I've been quite happy with Tinn-R due to its syntax highlighting functionality. Any suggestions for Macs?

Best
Chris

--
PD Dr. Christoph Rühlemann
Vertretungsprofessur
Englische Sprachwissenschaft
Institut für Anglistik und Amerikanistik
Universität Paderborn
Warburger Str. 100
33098 Paderborn
Büro: C3.341
Tel: (05251) 60-3804

https://www.uni-marburg.de/fb10/iaa/institut/personal/ruehlemann

ἰχθύς

messages.body_plain:
​If you decide to use emacs (I'm with Matías here), you might want to look at Kieran Healy's Starter Kit for the Social Sciences
http://kieranhealy.org/resources/emacs-starter-kit/

It has everything you'll need to make emacs and R work (and very much else like LaTeX, org-mode, etc.).

joan-josep vallbé
